name: pushed
character: Ahead of the beat: the hi-hat pushes the pulse and is accented, the snare leans in slightly, the kick stays on the grid.

provenance.direction: Câmara et al. 2020a/b and 'There's More to Timing than Time' (Music Perception 2024): pushed strokes are earlier and more intense; jazz drummers play the hi-hat 2-26 ms ahead of the pulse (JNMR 2017).
provenance.ms: starting value inside the measured 2-26 ms hi-hat lead
